profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at EagleView
profile.summary: Highly accomplished applied scientist with a strong background in physics, applied mathematics, statistical analysis, modeling & simulation, and computer programming within the defense and intelligence sectors. Expert in transforming experimental data to support physics-based simulation analysis, model verification & validation, and system performance test & evaluation. Excel at designing, modeling, and testing technology innovations for defense and intelligence applications. Experienced at preparing and conducting simulations, developing program concepts and metrics, and determining viability. Current Operations Researcher with Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory and former Scientific, Engineering, & Technical Advisor (SETA) with Intelligence Advanced Research Projects Activity (IARPA) and Principal Investigator with the Naval Research Laboratory (NRL).

positions.title: Operations Research Scientist
positions.description: Perform research into multi-disciplinary technical areas to support operations and threat assessment for the Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory (JHU/APL). Design technical studies intended to help stakeholders make informed acquisition and operations decisions. Investigate prior works to identify key capability gaps to prioritize future investment areas. Conduct technical studies, including performance metrics analysis, modeling and simulation, and experimental data analysis, to achieve task objectives. Lead small multi-disciplinary teams to accomplish sub-task objectives.

company.name: The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory

positions.title: Independent Consultant/Technical SETA
positions.description: Conducted research into multiple areas of interest for Intelligence Advanced Research Projects Activity organization within the Office of the Director of National Intelligence, with a focus on cyber attack detection and forecasting. Designed conceptual programs, evaluated state of the art technologies, and initiated research to drive innovation and support global threat deterrence and forecasting with emphasis on cyber attacks and internet security. Conducted background research and identify potential issues and technical challenges. Determined viability and risk vs. reward. Created conceptual test and evaluation approaches and determined/refined performance metrics and operational requirements.

positions.title: Senior Research Physicist
positions.description: Carried out research in a wide range of areas for the US Navy, including EO/IR ship and maritime background modeling and simulation, nighttime detection modeling, and ShipIR/Naval Threat Countermeasure Simulator (NTCS) projects. Served as Principal Investigator for multiple programs. Prepared cost and resource estimates and proposals. Responsible for conceptualized and assigned projects. Trained and mentored junior scientists. Supervised project teams. Led modeling, model verification/validation/accreditation, and experimental design and simulation automation.
